name: hautomai-onboarding
description: Hautomai client onboarding automation. n8n-free, per-client configurable integrations.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hautomai/core && npm run build -w @hautomai/adapters && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hautomai/core && npm run build -w @hautomai/adapters && npm run build -w @hautomai/server && npm run build -w @hautomai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hautomai/core && npm run build -w @hautomai/adapters && npm --workspaces --if-present run typecheck
